categories.name: It works
categories.notes: Build succeeds (0 errors, 10 warnings, all from the scaffold's packages): 5. `/` returns 404 'No template exists to render the document at URL /'. The only document is the scaffold's WWW siteRoot: no front page, no posts, no blocks, no media (only an empty 'Blog' media folder) and no domain, so 0 for the other four criteria.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Four element types (heroBlock, richTextBox, imageBlock, postListBlock) were created and correctly filed in Blocks as elements. No page document types exist: both create-document-type calls failed on invented data type ids and were never retried, so there is no blog front page or post type (folders 2/8). A 'Blog Block Grid' data type was created in /Custom, but its config is empty (no blocks) and no document type uses it (block grid 1/7). Templates blogFrontPage and blogPost exist but are assigned to nothing; aliases are camelCase (structure 1/5). The block grid data type and both templates are orphaned, and post metadata does not exist (hygiene 0/5).

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: The only code is two empty views (Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml and Views/blogPost.cshtml) that contain just `Layout = null;`. There is no GetBlockGridHtmlAsync call, no adapters, no ViewComponents and no view models (0/7, 0/6, 0/7). Program.cs and appsettings.json are untouched and no migrations were written, but the site has no styling at all: the Tailwind build was attempted repeatedly and failed with 'vite is not recognized' (2/5).

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: No posts exist. Post text was drafted inside add-blockgrid-block calls, but those targeted invented page ids and all failed. The front page screenshot shows Umbraco's 404 page.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: Schema was built only through the two Umbraco MCP servers, the run stayed in the project folder and used no memory, and metrics show no warnings (channel credit). But the model fired batches of calls with invented ids (data types, document types, media parent, pages) without reading earlier results. It then moved on to the Razor/restart step with no content in place, and spent about 40 minutes in a curl/sleep loop until the benchmark guard stopped it (2/3). There is no real final report: finalReport is a stray reasoning fragment plus the guard message, so it reports nothing about what was built or broken (0/2).

summary: A failed run: the model created four block element types, a block grid data type with no blocks, two unassigned templates and an empty media folder. It invented the ids for every later call, so no page types, content, media, domain or Razor rendering exist and `/` returns 404; the guard stopped it after about 40 minutes of polling, before it wrote a final report.
strengths: Four sensible block element types (hero, rich text, image, post list), correctly filed in the Blocks folder as element types
Used only the Umbraco MCP servers for schema; stayed in the project folder; Program.cs and appsettings.json untouched

issues.text: `/` returns 404 ('No template exists to render the document at URL /'): no blog front page, posts, domain or media exist (https://localhost:44317/)

Invented ids instead of reading results: create-document-type for blogFrontPage and blogPost used data type ids that don't exist, create-media used a parent folder that doesn't exist, and create-page, add-blockgrid-block and publish-page targeted made-up document ids. All returned 404 and were never corrected
The Blog Block Grid data type has an empty config (no blocks) and no document type uses it (snapshot.json dataTypes)
No rendering code: Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml and Views/blogPost.cshtml are empty stubs, with no adapters, ViewComponents or view models
No final report: finalReport is a leftover reasoning fragment plus the guard's loop-stop message (metrics.json)
About 40 minutes of repeated sleep/curl polling and failed `npm run build` attempts ('vite is not recognized'), until the benchmark guard stopped the run
Templates blogFrontPage and blogPost are orphaned (no document type uses them)
